deploybot: PREDEPLOY-EVAL FAILED for release v2.3.1 (prompt-suite v5). Metric: answer_relevance down 5.6% (p=0.008) across 500-sample sweep. Holding canary.

mike.dev: ugh. sample?

sara.prod: dropping the top-10 diffs here:
```
-- baseline: 'The meeting is at 10am PST.'
++ candidate: 'Meeting is tomorrow at 10am.'  <-- incorrect date shift
-- baseline: 'Refunds processed in 3-5 business days.'
++ candidate: 'Refunds will be instant.'  <-- factual change
... (snip, 12/500 showing shifted facts)
```

anil.ml: looks like a new quant-profile was applied in the canary bundle (q8->q5) in the last build. can anyone confirm the build id?

mike.dev: build tag is rdx/summarizer:2026-03-21-qa1 (CI #4123).

jen.releases: @emma.prod can you sign off on holding the release? product impact seems user-facing NLU regressions.

emma.prod: :eyes: holding makes sense. need severity triage. how many users affected in canary?

sara.prod: canary traffic ~1.2% global (~60k req/day). current failures ~0.9% of canary requests for the prompt-suite we ran. projected at scale ~0.02% of overall traffic but high severity for billing/nlp flows.

anil.ml: quick triage plan: 1) bisect to confirm if quant change caused regression 2) if confirmed, pin canary to previous quant/model variant 3) run another 500-sample sweep 4) if sweep clears, continue staged rollout; else rollback.

mike.dev: can we pin just EU and APAC regions and keep NA on the new build to reduce blast radius?

deploybot: ACTION: pin model rdx-summarizer@2026-03-15-stable to routes: eu, apac. TTL: manual-unpin. Command used: `/deploybot pin --model rdx-summarizer@2026-03-15-stable --routes eu,apac --reason "preflight eval regression"`

jen.releases: done the pin. :white_check_mark: EU/APAC now on stable variant. NA remains canary.

emma.prod: thanks. @anil.ml how long for bisect and re-run?

anil.ml: bisect run started (ticket REQ-1234). ETA 40m for first pass. re-run eval after bisect ~30m.

sara.prod: creating a quick dashboard for the failing prompts + examples. share link once ready.

mike.dev: SRE: is there any capacity or latency impact from switching route pins?

jen.releases: @sre-oncall (cc in case) but pins are config-level, not infra, so no capacity change expected.

emma.prod: ok, keep release window paused for now. if bisect shows quant-profile, let's schedule a new build with q8 fallback and run smoke.

deploybot: NOTE: release window for v2.3.1 remains PAUSED. To override: `/deploybot override --reason "product signoff"` (requires 2 approvals).

mike.dev: tagging this thread in the release notes PR: http://go/release/REQ-1234. I'll add the regression summary + chosen mitigation (regional pin + bisect).

anil.ml: bisect update: root cause prelim = quantization profile change in kernel-quant patch. reproduces locally. next: faster hotfix with previous quant settings + sanity sweep.

emma.prod: proceed with hotfix build and keep me looped. If hotfix clears eval and QA, we can resume rollout; otherwise we'll revert the canary entirely. :thumbsup:

jen.releases: thanks all. closing loop: pin in eu/apac, bisect in progress, hotfix branching. will post final decision here.

sara.prod: dashboard: http://go/metrics/REQ-1234-failures (summary + examples).

deploybot: THREAD NOTE: last automated check at 1749876610.
